captions.text:
FIND ONE COLOUR
AND FOLLOW IT.

SEEMS SIMPLE
FOR APPROXIMATELY ONE
SECOND.

MY BRAIN HAS OPENED
SIX NEW TABS.

NONE OF THEM
REMEMBER
WHY WE CAME HERE.
